name: Porta Westfalica (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged towards the hoist with the city arms of Porta Westfalica (a white castle with three towers above a red eagle on white).
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident in Detmold of 12 November 1973 the city of Porta Westfalica was granted the right to bear arms and a flag; the hoisted flag is divided red and white with the city arms shifted from the centre towards the staff.

features.role: Porta Westfalica arms — castle and eagle
